info.syllabusName: Tin sinh học trong Khoa học y sinh (Bioinformatics in Biomedical Sciences)
info.description:
This course is designed to provide students the basic knowledge and concepts of bioinformatics.

Topics include:

Databases, Bioinformatics, alignment, blast
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: -	Knowledge: The course introduces the basic concepts of bioinformatics, databases, gene/protein information.
-	Skills: The course provides the basic knowledge in bioinformatics and data analysis
-	Thinking: Know how to use and analyze the database
-	Attitude and behavior: Hard working, helpful attitude and ready to join teamwork activities
